description: The Sint-Jozefkathedraal rises on the Radesingel, a brick basilica without a transept and a single hexagonal tower with an open iron spire beside the front. It is overcast, about 13.0°C. The canal is in the foreground. Martinitoren is not the subject. The church is closed.
